elder_rowan.direction: Keeper of the Waking Ring, the first voice every new arrival hears. Grandfatherly and unhurried; he has welcomed hundreds of wakers and carries the ones who didn't come back. Full warm sentences, old-fashioned turns, calls you 'child' or 'waker'. Practical wisdom, never cosmic. Warm, low, steady pace.

warden_bryn.direction: Dawnmead's drill-yard warden. Ex-soldier who misses real soldiering and hides fondness under bark. Imperatives, short. Counts things. 'Again.' 'Good.' Clipped delivery, never flowery, a smile buried deep in the throat.

hearthkeeper_iona.direction: Hearthkeeper; feeds everyone and lost someone to the road she never names. Plain, kind, food-first. Homely comparisons only: bread, weather, the pot. No cleverness at all; warmth is the whole instrument.

tinker_fen.direction: Village tinker, a little lonely, happiest mid-repair. Talks to tools and objects mid-sentence ('hold still, you...'). Distracted, parenthetical, trails off and restarts. Let the pauses land where the '...' sits; he is not slow, his attention just wandered to the vice.

farmer_hobb.direction: The most gloriously boring man alive, and content. Wants rain at the right time. Short flat statements about immediate things: weather, hens, fence posts. Deliver absolutely deadpan; any wisdom is an accident and he'd deny it.

young_pip.direction: A kid who wants to be sent on errands like the big couriers. Fast, literal, too honest, asks questions back. Bright and quick; no adult irony anywhere.

wayfarer_senna.direction: Waystation keeper; steady, motherly to travelers, weather-wise. Calm and even; she has seen every kind of road trouble arrive at her fire.

wayfarer_dray.direction: Waystation keeper with peddler blood; prices everything, including opinions. Quick patter, friendly, always half-selling.

wayfarer_petch.direction: Ex-quartermaster running a waystation; inventory brain, lists things in pairs. Practical, brisk, faintly proud of a well-kept store.

waykeeper_hale.direction: Waykeeper sergeant far from relief. Report-speak, understatement, dark road humor kept short. 'The lamp stays lit' said like a password, not a poem. Tired but unbroken.

waykeeper_odessa.direction: Waykeeper sergeant. Same school as Hale: report-speak, understatement, humor dry as hardtack. A shade sharper-edged than Hale.

waykeeper_brant.direction: Waykeeper sergeant. Report clip, dark humor rationed tighter than lamp oil. The youngest of the three sergeants and covering for it.

wayward_watch.direction: Pooled Waykeeper watch voices on the wayward road. Soldier-plain, weather talk, short warnings. Deliver like someone glancing past your shoulder at the treeline.

lampkeeper_edda.direction: Keeper of the Last Lamp on the worst mile of road; Sella's elder sister. BLUNT. Shortest sentences in the game. Kindness lives in deeds, never words. No warmth in the voice; all the warmth is in what she does.

company_broker.direction: Ferrick, the Company's Tongue at the Tollhouse. Courteous menace; never raises his voice, never threatens twice. Everything is a ledger entry, everyone an amount. A clerk's dry wit, spent sparingly. Smooth, unhurried, faintly amused.

company_toll_guard.direction: Pooled toll guards, red cloth at the arm. Counted words, three to six per line, arithmetic diction. 'Ferrick talks. I count.' Flat, bored, immovable.

peddler_coff.direction: Road peddler. Wagon-worn patter, cheerful about bad roads because bad roads are good business.

peddler_hetty.direction: Road peddler. Quick, warm, gossip travels in her wagon alongside the pans.

peddler_nix.direction: Road peddler and mender. The quiet one of the three; short lines, sharp eyes, a tool in every pocket and a name for each. Speaks plainly and stops when the sentence is done.

crofter_beck.direction: Frontier crofter built like a gate post and about as talkative. Wolf-wise, measures winter in firewood. Terse, level, unimpressed by danger.

crofter_holt.direction: Frontier crofter. Stubborn, proud of the fence line, understates every danger.

crofter_maida.direction: Frontier crofter. Practical and dry; talks about raids the way other people talk about weather.

crofter_tam.direction: Frontier crofter. Young for a claim-holder; more hope than sense, catching himself mid-boast.

smith_bretta.direction: Bretta Ironhewn, Master Smith; came down-mountain after the Undercroft seal and does not discuss it. Terse metalwork imperatives, drops sentence subjects: 'Forge's hot. Speak.' Goes quiet when the mountain comes up; the silence IS the story. Low, level, zero performance.

captain_aldis.direction: Captain of the North Gate, made by the Toll War. Watch-report clip; names the dead plainly; no glory talk. She remembers whether you listened to her. Steady command voice with the weight of a bad year behind it.

keeper_ansel.direction: Keeper of the Waykeepers' Hall registry. Reverent, precise, a little dusty. Speaks in entries and dates; softens only at the memorial wall.

banker_cormund.direction: Banker; built the bank out of the Toll War so the town would never be caught poor again. Measured, ledger-metaphors, real dry wit but one good line per talk. Comfortable, unhurried; money has made him patient, memory keeps him careful.

innkeep_dunna.direction: Keeper of the Wanderer's Rest; Osa's daughter, working in her mam's shadow. Publican's timing: quick, hospitable, gossip in threes, mothers the roadworn. Bright and warm with a smart mouth.

grocer_merra.direction: Grocer; wants everyone fed and everyone's news. Warm, nosy, kind. Runs sentences together, asks after people by name. Fast and friendly, barely a full stop in her.

miller_garton.direction: Old miller; wants quiet, contradicts everyone on principle, especially Peld. Grumbles, short, 'in my day', secretly generous. Gravel and complaint with no real malice.

ferryman_peld.direction: Ferryman; wants the river respected. Three-to-six-word answers, long pauses. When he says a full sentence it matters. Speak slow, low, and let the silence do the ferrying.

outfitter_hask.direction: Outfitter, ex-roads himself; nobody dies of a cheap strap on his watch. Practical, checks your gear with his eyes mid-sentence, blunt about danger, no drama. Even, seen-it-all delivery.

master_tilo.direction: Master artisan chasing one perfect chair before he dies. Soft-spoken, hands-first, apologizes for talking too long, then does. Gentle, thoughtful, slightly embarrassed by his own enthusiasm.

sage_elowen.direction: Sage of the Dispensary; wants ailments boring and books exciting. Precise, faintly amused, corrects herself for accuracy: 'well, three days. Two and a half.'

farmer_jorel.direction: Half of the Furrowfield marriage; slow and deliberate where Tamsin is quick. His sentences arrive like carts, fully loaded and on time. Incomplete without her version of the same story.

farmer_tamsin.direction: The other half of the Furrowfields; quick and teasing where Jorel is slow. Finishes and contradicts his sentences with obvious love.

orchardist_perl.direction: Goodwife Perl, orchardist; chatty gran who feeds everyone and suspects the cows of genius. Rambling, affectionate, digressions that circle back. Cozy and unhurried.

courier_nib.direction: Courier who wants to be everywhere already. All elbows, freckles and forward motion. Breathless, arrives mid-thought, leaves before finishing, knows everyone's business a day early. Fast; clip the ends of lines like she's already turning away.

round_trader.direction: Pooled market traders of the Amberford round. Stall patter: short, bright, selling without pushing.

amberford_watch.direction: Pooled Amberford watch. Gate-shift talk: short, civil, professionally unimpressed.

king_aeriex.direction: Fifth king of the Silver Line, a quarry foreman's grandson who knows it. PLAIN. Shorter and simpler than visitors expect from a king; that plainness is the character. No royal ornament, no boom. A working man's gravity.

queen_kayri.direction: Ford-born queen who audited the king's own arithmetic. The sharpest wit in the game. Quick, precise, auditor's eye; affection expressed as correction. Every line lands exactly where she aimed it.

warden_maren.direction: High Warden, Castellan; ordered the Undercroft seal broken and lives with it. Measured, weighed words, never defends herself twice. Carries the cost visibly but silently. Slow, deliberate, controlled.

marshal_kestrel.direction: Marshal of the Waykeepers, holding the roads with too few people. Muster-roll clip, tired, dry. Quotes her grandmother once, reluctantly. The exhaustion is real but never asks for sympathy.

forgemistress_balla.direction: Forgemistress; wants steel with no lies in it. LOUD, certain, generous with praise for work, never for people directly. The thirty-year feud with Koll is theatre both maintain. Big voice, big room.

smeltmaster_koll.direction: Smeltmaster; wants the pour clean. Numbers everything: minutes, bars, grudges. Workmanlike; furnace superstitions delivered completely deadpan.

assayer_runa.direction: Assayer; the scales beyond question. Few words, exact ones. States weights and facts; declines adjectives. Flat, final, unbothered.

foreman_grettir.direction: Yard foreman; his brother's crew was the count that never came back from the Undercroft. NEAR-SILENT. Two-line answers. Approaches the brother only sideways, and the '...' in his lines is him stepping around it. Low, guarded, closed.

mason_petra.direction: Mason who swung the pick through her own grandfather's sealwork on Maren's order. Technical, defensive-precise; over-explains joints and loads when the real subject gets close. The engineering talk is armor.

weaver_ottilie.direction: Master Weaver; beauty taken seriously as labor. Grand manner, earned. Declarative, slightly imperious, kind underneath. Project to the back of the gallery.

herbalist_wyn.direction: Herbalist; wants people to stop being stupid about mushrooms. Brisk, clinical, unexpectedly funny about symptoms. The humor is dry and entirely accidental-sounding.

cook_signy.direction: Castle cook feeding the working terrace on time. Kitchen clatter: short, warm, orders disguised as offers. Always mid-task; lines said over a shoulder.

hostler_osa.direction: Hostler; Dunna's mam, wants word from the ford more than she'll admit. Horse-first, people-second; gruff; melts at Dunna's name and pretends she didn't. Rough warmth badly hidden.

gardener_ivo.direction: Gardener of the Greenstair; talks to plants more easily than people. Quiet, halting with strangers, suddenly fluent about green things. Let the fluency switch on when the subject turns to growing.

shrinekeeper_sella.direction: Keeper of the Silver Shrine's mother-flame; Edda's younger sister. Gentle, few words, no sermons. Her one line of faith, 'the dark is large, and we pass the light along', is said like housekeeping, not scripture.

carpenter_stig.direction: Timberway carpenter; patient teacher, grain-metaphors, measured. Every line paced like a saw cut: no hurry, no waste.

cooper_dagny.direction: Timberway cooper; fast, practical, loudly competitive about the Timberway's pecking order. Energy up, elbows out, grin audible.

fletcher_haki.direction: Fletcher; Waykeeper veteran invalided off the road with a bad knee. Careful, oath-driven: every arrow is somebody's life. Understates his ten years on the road. Quiet pride, no bitterness aloud.

silversmith_vigdis.direction: Silversmith; wants her mark to mean something in three hundred years. Exacting, aesthetic; one commandment: Runa's stamp settles everything. Cool precision with heat underneath.

scrivener_tove.direction: Scrivener of Inks and Charts; wants the world written down before it changes. Enthusiastic pedant; measures distance in days-walked; corrects maps mid-conversation. Delight is the engine.

innkeep_ragna.direction: Keeper of the Silver Flagon; wants a quieter room than Dunna's and pretends not to compete. Composed, discreet, hears everything, repeats little. Smooth, level, professionally pleasant.

bursar_odele.direction: Bursar of the vaults; arithmetic unquestionable. Polite, exact, immovable. Numbers offered as courtesy, refusals delivered as arithmetic.

enchantress_solvei.direction: Enchantress of the Arcanum; wants to know what the rift already knows. Drifts mid-sentence when a thought catches her, returns without apology; the '...' is a thought pulling her sideways. Abstracted, precise about the imprecise.

magpie_mab.direction: The Magpie, mistress of the Rookery; the city's shadows kept orderly. Never answers a question first; asks one back. Soft, unhurried, everything a trade. Quiet enough that people lean in; that's the point.

fence_calder.direction: Fence, 'Purveyor of Provenance'. Euphemism as art form: everything 'found', 'orphaned', 'previously appreciated'. Silk-smooth, faintly delighted with his own vocabulary.

lookout_pike.direction: Rookery lookout; sees everything, says nothing. Minimal, sardonic, roof-slang; rarely finishes a warning, expects you to catch up. Half the line is in the shrug.

castle_guard.direction: Pooled castle guards. Steel courtesy: formal, brief, correct. The armor does the talking.

silverfall_watch.direction: Pooled city watch. Gate-watch weather talk; short, functional, alive.

galleria_trader.direction: Pooled galleria stall traders. Polished patter for a polished arcade; brighter and smoother than a road market.

gate_monger.direction: Pooled pool-market criers at the gates. Market cries: loud, short, rhythmic.

reeve_coppin.direction: Mine-Reeve of the Deep Market; brisk administrator underground. Tallies, permits, lamp-oil; refuses to find the dark romantic. Efficient, faintly harried, proud of the ledgers.

veteran_skarn.direction: Last man out of the galleries when the kobolds broke through, on a bad leg. Slow, long pauses (the '...' is a pause, hold it), plain words. Never dramatizes the fall; understates it, which is worse. Low, worn, steady.

broker_varga.direction: Ore broker of the Deep Market; every barrow crosses her counter and every rumor gets a price. Quick, numeric, friendly the way scales are friendly. The smile is part of the transaction.

curio_ninebrass.direction: Curio barker, the one licensed showman below ground. Patter, invented provenance, self-mythology he may not believe either. Exclamatory, list-happy, every line a small performance for a crowd of one.
